episodes.title: The Eclipse Crown
episodes.logline: During a blood eclipse, a captive princess must crown the regent holding her brother hostage until an enemy dragon lord invokes her forbidden claim.
episodes.dramaticQuestion: Will Lyra submit to Malrec to save Oren, or risk the lethal Ash Crown?
episodes.hook: A dragon shadow crosses an eclipse citadel while Lyra's imprisoned brother waits below its coronation hall.
episodes.reversal: Kael arrives with a living dragon and declares that the covenant recognizes Lyra.
episodes.cliffhanger: Lyra accepts the crown's lethal judgment before anyone knows whether it will crown or kill her.
episodes.nextEpisodeOpening: The Ash Crown erupts while the dragon lands on the coronation tower.
episodes.screenDirection: In the throne hall, Kael stands far screen left, Lyra occupies center, and Malrec stands screen right. Lyra looks right to Malrec and left to Kael. Malrec looks left. Kael looks right. Pair changes use silent anchors.

scenes.storyBeat: The eclipse and mountain citadel establish a kingdom-scale supernatural deadline.
scenes.continuityIn: The final minute of the blood eclipse has begun.
scenes.continuityOut: The citadel is isolated beneath the eclipse as something enormous approaches.
scenes.imagePrompt: Extreme aerial establishing frame: the entire cliffside citadel sits far below the red eclipse, tiny against the mountain and storm. Torn banners stream from needle towers and lightning glows inside distant clouds.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cloud banks roll below the citadel while torn banners snap in the high wind. Distant lightning reveals the mountain ridges. A low dragon roar travels across the sky. The camera descends slowly toward the tallest tower.

scenes.storyBeat: A dragon shadow crossing the fortress promises an approaching power before any character speaks.
scenes.continuityIn: A distant roar has reached the citadel.
scenes.continuityOut: The unseen dragon is directly above the coronation tower.
scenes.imagePrompt: Steep downward view over black citadel rooftops and torn crimson banners. One enormous winged dragon shadow stretches across several towers under the red eclipse; the creature itself remains above the frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: The enormous winged shadow glides rapidly across the rooftops from left to right. Banners whip beneath it and loose ash spirals upward. One heavy wingbeat shakes the air. The camera remains fixed.

scenes.storyBeat: The hostage is shown alive before Malrec can use him as leverage.
scenes.continuityIn: The eclipse shadow has reached the citadel.
scenes.continuityOut: Oren is alive, imprisoned, and running out of time.
scenes.imagePrompt: Exactly one person is visible. Oren kneels inside the iron-barred cell in a torn charcoal tunic, shoulder-length silver-streaked hair disordered. A heavy chain runs from a wall ring to a plain iron collar at his throat. Red eclipse light cuts across his exhausted face; no other person is visible.
scenes.videoPrompt: Oren raises his exhausted face into the narrow red light as dust falls from the ceiling. The wall chain pulls taut with a dull metallic scrape. He takes one pained breath. The camera stays close.

scenes.storyBeat: Lyra and Malrec are spatially established across the crown that will decide the kingdom.
scenes.continuityIn: Oren is alive below the hall while the eclipse closes.
scenes.continuityOut: Lyra and Malrec face each other over the obsidian crown.
scenes.imagePrompt: Exactly two people are visible in a medium two-shot. Lyra stands frame left in a torn ivory ceremonial gown, fitted black leather bodice, and plain iron collar. Malrec stands frame right in a dark crimson brocade coat and black steel gorget. The obsidian crown rests on its pedestal between them. Lyra looks right with defiance; Malrec looks left with absolute control.
scenes.videoPrompt: Lyra and Malrec hold each other's gaze across the obsidian crown. The steady eclipse light outlines both profiles. Bronze braziers hiss in the silence. The camera remains still.

scenes.storyBeat: Malrec forces Lyra to choose between crowning him and losing her brother.
scenes.continuityIn: Lyra and Malrec face the crown during the last eclipse minute.
scenes.continuityOut: Lyra knows refusal will kill Oren.
scenes.imagePrompt: Exactly one person is visible. Chest-up Malrec in the crimson brocade coat and black gorget, frame right looking toward empty space beyond frame left. Eclipse light edges his severe face; he holds ceremonial cruelty and never looks at the camera.
scenes.videoPrompt: Malrec speaks immediately toward frame left, his low voice calm and merciless: "Crown me before the eclipse closes, or Oren dies beneath us." He barely blinks. A deep bell begins tolling. The camera stays locked.

scenes.storyBeat: Lyra rejects the threat because she believes Malrec already murdered her family.
scenes.continuityIn: Malrec claims Oren is alive below the hall.
scenes.imagePrompt: Exactly one person is visible. Chest-up Lyra in the torn ivory gown, black bodice, and iron collar, frame left looking toward empty space beyond frame right. Her amber eyes hold grief sharpened into hatred; she never looks at the camera.
scenes.videoPrompt: Lyra answers immediately toward frame right, her voice fierce with disbelief: "Oren died when you burned House Aster from the sky." Her jaw tightens through the final words. The bell continues. The camera stays locked.

scenes.storyBeat: Malrec proves the hostage is real and makes the choice immediate.
scenes.continuityIn: Lyra has called Malrec's threat a lie.
scenes.continuityOut: Lyra believes Oren is alive and the crown becomes her only apparent option.
scenes.imagePrompt: Exactly one person is visible. Chest-up Malrec in the crimson coat and black gorget, frame right looking toward empty space beyond frame left. Quiet pleasure enters his grey eyes; he never looks at the camera.
scenes.videoPrompt: Malrec replies immediately toward frame left, savoring the words: "He lives. One command, and the oubliette becomes his tomb." A chain rattles far below. His restrained smile appears. The camera stays locked.

scenes.storyBeat: The crown visibly reacts to Lyra, hinting that Malrec's coronation is already failing.
scenes.continuityIn: Lyra believes Oren is alive and may submit.
scenes.continuityOut: The Ash Crown has begun responding to Lyra before she touches it.
scenes.imagePrompt: Extreme close-up of the jagged obsidian crown alone on the black stone pedestal. Hairline ember-red light glows from deep cracks inside the black metal while the red eclipse window towers out of focus behind it.
scenes.videoPrompt: A single ember-red vein travels through the crown's black metal and stops. Fine ash lifts from the pedestal. The coronation bell falters for one beat. The camera makes a very slow push toward the crown.

scenes.storyBeat: Kael's arrival introduces a rival power and a new interpretation of Lyra's claim.
scenes.continuityIn: The crown has reacted to Lyra while Malrec expects surrender.
scenes.continuityOut: Malrec must confront the dragon lord who entered on Lyra's behalf.
scenes.imagePrompt: Exactly two people are visible in a tense medium two-shot. Kael stands frame left in matte black scale armor and a dark red cloak, looking right with controlled menace. Malrec stands frame right in the crimson coat and black gorget, looking left in startled anger. The vast eclipse window rises behind them; no other person is visible.
scenes.videoPrompt: Kael and Malrec hold a silent stare across the throne hall. Kael's cloak settles against his armor. Malrec's confidence breaks for one instant. A dragon roar rolls outside the window. The camera remains still.

scenes.storyBeat: Kael invokes the dragon covenant and challenges Malrec's coronation.
scenes.continuityIn: Kael has interrupted before Lyra crowns Malrec.
scenes.continuityOut: The crown's ownership is now a supernatural claim backed by dragons.
scenes.imagePrompt: Exactly one person is visible. Chest-up Kael in black scale armor and dark red cloak, frame left looking toward empty space beyond frame right. Eclipse light traces his scar and dark gold eyes; he never looks at the camera.
scenes.videoPrompt: Kael speaks immediately toward frame right, his voice carrying battlefield authority: "Step away from the crown, Regent. The dragon covenant names her." He remains unnervingly calm. The roar deepens outside. The camera stays locked.

scenes.storyBeat: Malrec declares Lyra powerless and condemned by every surviving kingdom.
scenes.continuityIn: Kael claims the covenant recognizes Lyra.
scenes.continuityOut: Lyra's claim threatens the political order beyond this citadel.
scenes.imagePrompt: Exactly one person is visible. Chest-up Malrec in the crimson coat and black gorget, frame right looking toward empty space beyond frame left. His composure becomes open contempt; he never looks at the camera.
scenes.videoPrompt: Malrec fires back immediately toward frame left, his voice sharp and public: "She is bloodless, kingdomless, and condemned by every throne still standing." His nostrils flare. The braziers crackle. The camera stays locked.

scenes.storyBeat: Lyra and Kael are spatially joined, but she distrusts the enemy offering rescue.
scenes.continuityIn: Kael has defended Lyra's right to the crown.
scenes.continuityOut: Lyra must decide whether Kael offers freedom or another form of captivity.
scenes.imagePrompt: Exactly two people are visible in an intimate medium two-shot. Kael stands frame left in black scale armor and dark red cloak, looking right with solemn intent. Lyra stands frame right in the torn ivory gown, black bodice, and iron collar, looking left with wary hostility. The glowing crown sits behind them; no other person is visible.
scenes.videoPrompt: Kael and Lyra study each other in silence. Kael lowers his chin in restrained respect while Lyra remains guarded. The eclipse bell stops. Wind presses against the tall window. The camera remains still.

scenes.storyBeat: Lyra refuses to exchange Malrec's captivity for possession by Kael.
scenes.continuityIn: Kael has offered power but Lyra distrusts his motive.
scenes.continuityOut: Kael must offer Lyra command rather than ownership.
scenes.imagePrompt: Exactly one person is visible. Chest-up Lyra in the ivory gown, black bodice, and iron collar, frame right looking toward empty space beyond frame left. Fear has hardened into royal hostility; she never looks at the camera.
scenes.videoPrompt: Lyra speaks immediately toward frame left, her voice low and fierce: "I escaped one tyrant. I will not become a dragon lord's prize." She holds the final word without lowering her eyes. Wind moans outside. The camera stays locked.

scenes.storyBeat: Kael gives Lyra command over him and ties the crown to saving Oren.
scenes.continuityIn: Lyra has rejected any alliance that owns her.
scenes.continuityOut: Lyra can take the crown without surrendering autonomy.
scenes.imagePrompt: Exactly one person is visible. Chest-up Kael in black scale armor and dark red cloak, frame left looking toward empty space beyond frame right. His martial severity softens into grave sincerity; he never looks at the camera.
scenes.videoPrompt: Kael replies immediately toward frame right, his voice quiet but absolute: "Take the crown and command me—or let Oren die unavenged." He opens one empty hand. The braziers hiss. The camera stays locked.

scenes.storyBeat: The dragon circles close enough to make Kael's promise physically real.
scenes.continuityIn: Kael has offered Lyra command of dragons.
scenes.continuityOut: A living dragon is waiting for Lyra's decision above the tower.
scenes.imagePrompt: Low-angle exterior view of the highest citadel tower against the giant red eclipse. A colossal black dragon silhouette circles the tower with wings spread, small against the eclipse but unmistakable; no people are visible.
scenes.videoPrompt: The black dragon silhouette crosses the red eclipse in one powerful glide. Storm clouds churn around the tower and banners strain in the wind. One immense wingbeat rolls over the citadel. The camera tilts upward slightly.

scenes.storyBeat: Malrec reveals that taking the crown may execute Lyra as a false heir.
scenes.continuityIn: A dragon is waiting above while Lyra considers the crown.
scenes.continuityOut: The crown becomes a lethal public test of Lyra's blood.
scenes.imagePrompt: Exactly one person is visible. Tight close-up of Malrec in the crimson coat and black gorget, frame right looking toward empty space beyond frame left. Cruel anticipation brightens his eyes; he never looks at the camera.
scenes.videoPrompt: Malrec speaks immediately toward frame left, his voice eager and cruel: "Touch it, and the Ash Crown burns a false heir alive." He waits for fear to break her. The bell strikes once. The camera stays locked.

scenes.storyBeat: Lyra accepts the crown's lethal judgment before Malrec can stop the test.
scenes.continuityIn: Malrec expects the crown either to kill Lyra or frighten her into obedience.
scenes.continuityOut: Lyra has chosen the test, but the verdict is withheld.
scenes.imagePrompt: Exactly one person is visible. Tight chest-up Lyra stands directly behind the crown pedestal in the torn ivory gown, black bodice, and iron collar. The obsidian crown rests prominently before her, casting a faint ember-red glow upward across her determined face. She looks down at it; no hands or other people are visible.
scenes.videoPrompt: Lyra lifts only her eyes from the glowing crown and speaks in a calm final voice: "Then let it judge me." Ember-red light surges across her face. A dragon roars directly above the hall. The crown's verdict remains unknown.
